name: team-synth
title: Team Synth Grid
blurb: Dark team showcase with gradient text and animated card reveals.
description: A dark section with animated heading (cyan-to-blue gradient text), team member cards with photos and roles, and gradient background overlays.
use_when: Modern team showcases or network sections where dark mode, gradient text, and animations create a tech-forward, premium…
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical contexts where gradient text readability is a concern or where animations should be reduced.
a11y: Team names and roles are readable text (not gradient-only). Heading hierarchy is semantic. Animations support motion preferences.
